name: Kirishima Saeko
source:
Slightly strong-willed, serious and cool personality tends to stick to things that interest her. A member of the Mama Association.

Her husband is away on a long business trip for work. She has no particular preference for shotas.

[From [url=https://www.spindle-game.com/spdl_012.html#char]Official website[/url]]
